jen (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — opening this Q&A thread for headcount/org questions. ask here and we'll respond through the week. :wave:
priya (VP People): TL;DR — target +40 FTE this quarter. primary focus: infra, runtime, product growth. we'll rebalance a few teams and pause some reqs temporarily.
sam (IC): can you share which teams are getting the most hires?
priya (VP People): allocation targets: Eng infra ~15, Runtime ~10, Product/PM ~8, Support/Success ~7. these are targets, not final.
derek (Eng Manager): are we hiring for senior ICs or more junior roles in infra?
priya (VP People): mix: ~40% senior (L4+/staff-hire), ~60% mid/junior. want a few experienced leads + several hands-on engineers.
annika (Product): will you prioritize internal transfers before external hiring?
priya (VP People): yes — internal moves are prioritized. expecting ~8-10 reallocations where it makes sense.
maya (Recruiter): recruiting note — job posts go live this week. i'll DM hiring managers for priority candidate profiles and interview panels.
sam (IC): timeline for the org changes mentioned in the all-hands?
jen (CEO): phased rollout. first wave (org chart updates + manager span adjustments) in ~2 weeks. hiring pause windows will be coordinated per team.
priya (VP People): impacted teams will get an email with next steps and 1:1 sign-ups by EOD Friday.
derek (Eng Manager): will the performance review / calibration schedule change because of this?
priya (VP People): no change to review timelines. calibration will include org-change context and folks will be informed if it affects leveling.
sam (IC): what's the plan for contractor spend during this ramp?
priya (VP People): we'll tighten contingent spend — pause or convert agency contractors where possible to prioritize FTEs.
annika (Product): any impact on Q2 roadmap commitments?
jen (CEO): core roadmap priorities stay. some non-critical projects may be deprioritized; product will publish updated priorities and a short impact matrix by next Wed.
sam (IC): is there a central doc / FAQ for folks impacted?
maya (Recruiter): yes — we'll post a short FAQ in #people-ops and tag affected teams once the email goes out.
derek (Eng Manager): how do we nominate internal candidates for moves?
priya (VP People): hiring managers can flag internal candidates via the internal transfer form in Workday — i'll post the link in the FAQ.
sam (IC): will there be office hours to ask questions live?
priya (VP People): office hours w/ People Ops Monday 3pm PT, jen + HR leads attending. drop questions here and we'll address during the session.
jen (CEO): thanks — appreciate the quick questions. we'll keep this thread updated after office hours and with follow-ups.
ops-bot: scheduled_reminder: Office hours (People Ops) on 1784594290 — join Zoom link in calendar
maya (Recruiter): small ask — panel interview scorecards should be added to Greenhouse ASAP; new panel format speeds decisions.
sam (IC): thanks all, appreciate the transparency.
